entries.title: Psalms 77:1
segments: ¶<To the chief music-maker. After Jeduthun. Of Asaph. A Psalm.> I was crying to God with my voice; even to God with my voice, and he gave ear to me.

entries.title: Psalms 77:2
segments: In the day of my trouble, my heart was turned to the Lord: my hand was stretched out in the night without resting; my soul would not be comforted.

entries.title: Psalms 77:3
segments: I will keep God in memory, with sounds of grief; my thoughts are troubled, and my spirit is overcome. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 77:4
segments: You keep my eyes from sleep; I am so troubled that no words come.

entries.title: Psalms 77:5
segments: My thoughts go back to the days of the past, to the years which are gone.

entries.title: Psalms 77:6
segments: The memory of my song comes back to me in the night; my thoughts are moving in my heart; my spirit is searching with care.

entries.title: Psalms 77:7
segments: Will the Lord put me away for ever? will he be kind no longer?

entries.title: Psalms 77:8
segments: Is his mercy quite gone for ever? has his word come to nothing?

entries.title: Psalms 77:9
segments: Has God put away the memory of his pity? are his mercies shut up by his wrath? (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 77:10
segments: And I said, It is a weight on my spirit; but I will keep in mind the years of the right hand of the Most High.

entries.title: Psalms 77:11
segments: ¶I will keep in mind the works of Jah: I will keep the memory of your wonders in the past.

entries.title: Psalms 77:12
segments: I will give thought to all your work, while my mind goes over your acts of power.

entries.title: Psalms 77:13
segments: Your way, O God, is holy: what god is so great as our God?

entries.title: Psalms 77:14
segments: You are the God who does works of power: you have made your strength clear to the nations.

entries.title: Psalms 77:15
segments: With your arm you have made your people free, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 77:16
segments: The waters saw you, O God; the waters saw you, they were in fear: even the deep was troubled.

entries.title: Psalms 77:17
segments: The clouds sent out water; the skies gave out a sound; truly, your arrows went far and wide.

entries.title: Psalms 77:18
segments: The voice of your thunder went rolling on; the world was flaming with the light of the storm; the earth was shaking.

entries.title: Psalms 77:19
segments: Your way was in the sea, and your road in the great waters; there was no knowledge of your footsteps.

entries.title: Psalms 77:20
segments: You were guiding your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
